input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, I maintain the INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE label.

H1 (Q4 2026 actual results): The retrieved evidence does not contain Q4 2026 actual results for Intel Foundry. E7 shows full year 2025 results (period ending Dec 27, 2025), and E9 shows Q3 2026 results (three months ended Sep 26, 2026) with an operating loss of $(1,853) million. Neither provides Q4 2026 actual results. The evidence_review confirms these are MISMATCH periods and RELATED_NOT_DECIDING.

H2 (Forward-looking guidance): E2 mentions expectations for Q4 2026 regarding charges from the Israel facility accident, but this is forward-looking (filed 2026-10-30, before Q4 2026 ended) and does not state that the foundry would reach break-even. The evidence_review confirms this is FORWARD_LOOKING and RELATED_NOT_DECIDING. No guidance or forecast about break-even was found.

H3 (Q4 2026 filings): No 10-K or earnings release covering Q4 2026 was retrieved. E7 is from the 2025 10-K (period ending Dec 27, 2025), which predates the claim period.

The claim specifically states "Intel's fourth-quarter 2026 results show" - this requires actual reported results for Q4 2026. All available evidence covers periods through Q3 2026 only (period ending Sep 26, 2026). The evidence cutoff date is 2026-11-15, which is before Q4 2026 would have ended (approximately Dec 27, 2026), explaining why Q4 2026 results are not available in the filings.

Without actual Q4 2026 financial results for Intel Foundry's operating income/loss, the claim cannot be verified.
